name: GameDay
intro: GameDay is a read-only page a church league shares with families. You will check the schedule, standings, practice times and gym details in the example league, make the words bigger, and see how it behaves with no internet and after a reload.

steps.do: Tap “skip the tour” (the small underlined words at the bottom right of the welcome card).
steps.see: The card changes to a last page with a big “Let’s go ›” button.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may show at the top for a few seconds. Tap it to close it, or just wait.

steps.see: The card closes. At the top: “🏀 GameDay” and “Immanuel Basketball (example league)”. Just below, a dashed box says “🧪 This is an example league — made-up teams and games…”.

steps.do: Look at the very top of the page, just under the blue title area.
steps.see: There is no red banner. (A red banner only appears there when the league cancels games.)

steps.do: Scroll to “📅 UPCOMING GAMES” and look at the first date card.
steps.see: The date is this coming Saturday (today, if today is Saturday). It lists three games at Immanuel Church Gym: “Blue Thunder vs Gold Rush” 9:00 AM, “Red Rockets vs Orange Crush” 10:00 AM, “Green Machine vs Purple Reign” 11:00 AM.

steps.do: Keep scrolling through the upcoming games.
steps.see: There are three Saturday cards in a row, one week apart, each with three games (9, 10 and 11 AM).

steps.do: Pretend your grandchild plays for the Red Rockets. Find their next game.
steps.see: On the first Saturday card: “Red Rockets vs Orange Crush” at 10:00 AM.
Blue Thunder is on top with a 👑 crown and 2 wins, 0 losses. Four teams are tied at 1–1 and marked “T-2”. Orange Crush is last, marked 6, with 0–2.

steps.do: Scroll to “⏰ PRACTICE TIMES” and find the Red Rockets.
steps.see: “Red Rockets — Tuesdays 7–8 PM”. Every one of the six teams has a practice time listed.
It shows “Immanuel Church Gym”, the address “2300 N. Dilleys Rd, Gurnee IL”, and “Enter door 4 by the playground · concessions open 8:30–noon · bring your own water bottle”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️).
steps.see: A brown strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The schedule is still all there to read.
The brown “No connection” strip goes away by itself.

steps.do: Tap the round “?” button on the right side of the screen, then tap “Aa Text size — bigger or smaller”.
steps.see: The panel closes and all the words on the page get bigger.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The page comes back with the same games, and the words are still the bigger size. A card “Keep GameDay on your Home Screen” pops up near the bottom.

steps.do: Scroll to the very bottom of the page.
steps.see: It says “When a game is cancelled, the league director puts it at the top of this page.” and the small print shows “GameDay v1.4 · 2026-10-08”.
